purpose: Establish the Learning Progress read/write boundary for homework and grades.
success_outcome: Students can complete assigned homework, teachers can record only the accepted grade scale, and prohibited students/parents cannot read another student's grade.
anti_goals: Do not expose grades through class-wide completion views.
Do not add late or partial attendance states here.
constraints: Learning Progress exclusively writes homework and grade state.
invariants: Homework completion is class-visible only within permitted context.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-001: role-based homework completion flow with permitted class visibility and out-of-context negative check.
FT-005-AC-002: accepted α/β/γ/F scale validation, positive student/family/teacher/admin matrix, and cross-student/parent denial.

stop_conditions: Stop if grade visibility requires changing the accepted access-control contract.
